provenance.evidence: ROM indexed title service 1 at 0x53B16 requires FFFC1E bit 0 set, bit 1 clear, scene/event 1/1, and FFF0D5 equal to zero. It opens 0xF49E8, whose room offer charges the FFF10D value 30 through command 0x06; command 0x16 marks FFFC1E bit 1 before the Tabatha Shale conversation. Successful payment enters 0xCF38 Hotel Options and remains outside.

ROM scene 1 record 68 at 0x17D9AC; event-table row 1 at 0x17D621 selects scene 53. ROM 0x1F65A selects the normal or run-result Inn prompt before the event-table destination; the prompt service returns D6=-1, so this row is retained as route evidence and is not entered through the standard prompt. Return policy: ROM 0xBC36/0xBD34 selects the collision-probe lead point; 0x2F32 restores the source scene. Lua link data records this point and faces away from the entrance on return.
